about: The collecta of the formulary “Sunday within the Octave of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Almighty, everlasting God, direct our deeds according to Your good pleasure, that in the name of Your beloved Son we may merit to abound in good works, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: who lives and reigns with You
